stories.headline: George Simion accused of lobbying against Romania's Visa Waiver status in the US
stories.summary: AUR leader George Simion faces explosive accusations from businessman Dragoș Sprânceană that he attempted to get Romania removed from the US Visa Waiver program for political gain. The allegations include claims Simion was intoxicated during meetings and made damaging statements to US officials.

stories.headline: PNL experiences internal tensions as Ilie Bolojan wins confidence vote but fails to remove regional leaders
stories.summary: PNL leader and PM Ilie Bolojan received a 47-3 confidence vote from party leadership but failed to secure the two-thirds majority needed to dismiss 10 regional party leaders with poor electoral results. The lengthy party meeting revealed deep internal divisions and resistance to Bolojan's reforms.

stories.headline: Marcel Ciolacu faces renewed criticism over governance record and corruption investigations
stories.summary: Former PM Marcel Ciolacu faces multiple lines of criticism including harsh words from Buzău mayor Constantin Toma about his leadership failures, budget blame from Bucharest mayor Ciprian Ciucu, and USR allegations about efforts to influence DNA investigations related to the Nordis case.

stories.headline: Klaus Iohannis' former protocol car auctioned by Sibiu municipality for €1,000
stories.summary: Sibiu municipality is auctioning President Klaus Iohannis' former protocol car, an Audi A6 3.2 FSI used when he was mayor, with a starting price of €1,000. The auction is part of the city's fleet renewal program.

stories.summary: Large-scale multinational NATO artillery exercises Dynamic Front 26 are taking place at Romanian training grounds from January 26 to February 13, 2026. US and Romanian forces conducted joint live-fire exercises at Smârdan and Cincu training areas.

stories.headline: AUR proposes elimination of housing taxes and presents legislative priorities
stories.summary: The Alliance for the Union of Romanians presented its legislative priorities including eliminating taxes on first homes and correcting injustices for disabled persons affected by tax increases. AUR argues the right to housing should not be treated as a luxury.

stories.summary: The Senate elected its new permanent bureau for the current session, with PSD, AUR, PNL and USR representatives taking vice-president, secretary and other positions. Group leaders were also announced for the parliamentary session.
